The Guild of Harwich Artists Group Trip to the Cahoon Museum of American Art in Cotuit – April 16, 2019

Guild Members will meet at the Harwich Community Center (right side of the building) on April 16 at 12:30 PM and carpool, arriving at the museum at approximately 1:30 PM.

The exhibit Twenty-One in Truro: Celebrating the Cahoon Museum Collection will be on display as well as other permanent and temporary exhibits. “Marking the 21st anniversary of the Cape Cod artists group, Twenty-One in Truro, the Cahoon Museum of American Art collaborated with these talented local artists on the special exhibition, Twenty-One in Truro: Celebrating the Cahoon Museum Collection.” Find more information on the Cahoon Museum website https://cahoonmuseum.org/#.

To attend contact e-mail Katherine Vacca at katherinevacca@comcast.net.
